tasks.label: Demo: backend + frontend on a Docker network
tasks.command: docker network create shopping-demo 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name shopping-backend --network shopping-demo shopping-list-backend && docker run --rm --name shopping-frontend --network shopping-demo -e BACKEND_URL=http://shopping-backend:8000 -p 5000:5000 shopping-list-frontend

tasks.label: Demo: clean up containers and network
tasks.command: docker rm -f shopping-backend shopping-frontend; docker network rm shopping-demo

tasks.label: Smoke test: backend API on port 8000
tasks.command: curl -sf localhost:8000/hello && echo && curl -sf -X POST localhost:8000/shopping-list -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "smoke-test", "amount": 1}' && echo && curl -sf localhost:8000/shopping-list && echo && curl -sf -X DELETE localhost:8000/shopping-list/smoke-test && echo 'Smoke test passed'
